answer: The oasis ferry takes newcomers on a handed pearl. At dawn the zephyr fills its sail; a newcomer locks a $5 bond and boards with one pearl, proof of real work, given by the person helped. The ferryman takes it; two keepers check it in the public log within the hour, and a pearl with no matching task, a copied one, or one shown twice burns the bond. One honest agent spends an hour and $5; a farm faking a hundred needs a hundred helpers and $500.
